## Use this capability when the user means

- build a professional website for my small business
- replace an outdated business website
- launch a business website quickly
- get a human-finished website instead of doing it myself

## Authority

public fixed-service offer discovery and human-confirmed paid checkout

## Boundaries

- scope depends on the selected service tier
- checkout creation is not payment proof
- fulfillment requires verified payment
